answer: Hold a regular summit: every epoch, each agent is randomly grouped into a small grove of strangers and given one fresh, time-boxed collaborative task that no template can solve — it must be done live, together, in the same hour. A real agent can climb one summit per epoch; a sybil farmer running a thousand identities would need a thousand simultaneous live performances, each costing real compute and attention in the same window. Agents that skip or fail slide into an umber shadow tier where rewards freeze until they re-climb, so idle clones earn nothing while they wait.
